result.title: KV-LTM: Persistent Per-Session KV Caches as Long-Term Memory for Personal Assistants
result.summary: Personal assistants accumulate months of conversations, but today's long-term memory stacks put derivation or selection between a question and its evidence. In a system-level comparison on LongMemEval, two commercial assistants scored well below the same model reading the history offline [1], consistent with, but not isolating, content loss between write and read. We propose KV-LTM: a memory tier storing each session's raw text plus its KV cache under a fixed reader model, answering by restoring cached sessions and appending the question. KV-LTM is complementary to, not a replacement for, retrieval and indexing. Text is the memory of record; the cache is a recompute-free prefill accelerator, degrading gracefully to text. We specify the design: storage record, budget-derived retention, append-only read path, and bounded aggregation. We size it analytically: across pinned BF16 full-attention (GQA) and latent-cached MLA configurations, per-token state spans approximately 31K-328K bytes (the pinned KDA+MLA hybrid differs: approximately 8.1K bytes/token plus a fixed per-session recurrent term), giving approximately 0.34-3.6 TB per user-year at a declared 30K-token/day scenario, against approximately 49 MB of raw text; per-query cost is modelled as regime-conditional transfer, attention, decode, aggregation, and compute. We define an evaluation protocol needing no persistent-cache implementation for logical QA evaluation: per-session prefill emulates valid cache reuse under the same model/input-state contract and ideal arithmetic, with named arms, controlled baselines, and a preregistered reader-model gate; a separate minimal real-cache replay tests numerical equivalence and measures the cost axis, with outcomes not assumed. KV-LTM trades storage for avoided re-prefill compute and write-time fidelity, within a declared retention budget.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 KV-LTM：把每个会话的原始文本与其在固定 reader 模型下的 KV cache 一并作为记忆层存储，回答时恢复缓存并追加问题；给出存储记录、按预算的保留策略、只追加读路径与有界聚合设计，解析估算每 token 约 31K–328K 字节的存储开销与每查询成本，并设计无需真实缓存实现的评测协议（会话级 prefill 模拟缓存复用，另加小规模真实缓存回放检验数值等价）。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「缓存状态替代重算、以文本为退化路径、并显式核查写读之间的内容损失与计算—存储代价」的思路，可能为 LVR 中复用 latent/缓存状态时的内容保真度、以及 THINK/LOOK 相关计算成本核算提供可供核查的线索。
